maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from advertisers' performance ad campaigns placed on publisher sites, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by private advertisers such as eToro, Hyundai, Bosch and Mercedes-Benz buying ads; publishers share revenue.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by expanding its ad platform and publisher partnerships; acquisitions such as Connexity or Gravity are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Advertisers can shift ad budgets among channels like search, social and display easily; publishers have some integration cost.

notes: Publisher-side recommendation tech has some switching cost, but advertiser revenue is the larger part.
